name: CBIT Internet
summary: Canberra dialup/TransACT/ADSL2+ + hosting + business IT ISP (16/65 Tennant St Fyshwick); absorbed Bandwidth Unlimited (3 Nov 2005) and Spitfire Internet Services (2 Feb 2009); retail ISP wound down after ~2018, pivoted to IT/data recovery/digital forensics/cybersecurity, now part of Excite Technology Services Group (CBIT PTY LIMITED, ACN 107 115 846).

events.details: CBIT Pty Limited ABN 16 107115846 ABN and GST active from 01 Apr 2004 (Canberra City); business name CBIT INTERNET registered 29 Apr 2005.

events.details: Retail ISP (dialup/ADSL/TransACT/hosting) still offered as 'CBIT Internet' through at least Feb 2018; subsequently pivoted to IT/data recovery/digital forensics/cybersecurity. Company remains active (cbit.net.au live 2026), now part of Excite Technology Services Group; CBIT PTY LIMITED (ABN 16 107 115 846) active, business names CBIT Digital Forensics Services (2015), Secure Data Recovery (2016), CBIT Data Recovery (2022).
